newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down ahead of budget.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down on selling pressure by investors ahead of Thursday's revenue budget for fiscal 1997/98 beginning on July 1, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index dropped 14.13 points or 1.21 percent at 1,145.48 on a turnover of 59.9 million taka. Losers led gainers by 103 to 37.

Brokers said the investors were cautious in trading as they avoided making fresh commitment before the announcement of the budget. Singer Bangladesh lost 75 taka to 6,328, Apex Foods fell 69 to 2,148 and Beximco Textile was up 8.30 to 148.43.
